categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three main business segments: high-performance organic pigments, specialty new materials, and material monomers. Its products serve industries such as inks, coatings, plastics, specialty films, engineering machinery, paper, rubber, electronics, and photovoltaic cells. The company also engages in the production of pigment intermediates and specialty polyurethane elastomers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced organic synthesis technologies, including ammonia oxidation as a key process, to produce high-performance organic pigments and specialty materials. It has developed proprietary technologies such as solvent recovery, surface treatment, dispersion optimization, and hydrogenation reduction. The company also integrates upstream production of core intermediates to control quality and cost, and employs automated production lines with strict quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large chemical companies like BASF, Clariant, LANXESS, DIC, Sherwin-Williams, Akzo Nobel, PPG, Nippon Paint, and various domestic and international manufacturers in coatings, inks, plastics, automotive, electronics, and packaging industries. The company serves both direct production customers and distributors, covering domestic and overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Liaoning (Anshan), Shandong, Shanghai, and other regions. It also has subsidiaries and trade operations in Hong Kong and Luxembourg, serving international markets including Japan, Thailand, Europe, and the Americas. The company is expanding its overseas market presence and conducting market research for global expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the chemical supply chain, producing high-performance organic pigments, specialty materials, and intermediates. It controls upstream raw material synthesis of key intermediates and supplies downstream industries such as coatings, inks, plastics, and specialty manufacturing sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening high-performance organic pigment business, expanding specialty new materials like PPDI-based polyurethane elastomers and MXD6 specialty nylon, and integrating ammonia oxidation technology. The company emphasizes innovation in environmentally friendly, high durability pigments and materials, digital transformation, and sustainable development aligned with national carbon neutrality goals. R&D centers in Shanghai and Anshan focus on advanced materials, process optimization, and new product development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of chemical products including organic pigments, pigment intermediates, and specialty materials. The company sells products both domestically and internationally via direct sales to manufacturers and through distributors. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on product sales and technical service support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global chemical giants such as BASF, Clariant, DIC, and LANXESS in the high-performance organic pigment market. It holds a strong domestic position with competitive advantages in technology, cost control, and product quality, and is recognized as a leading Chinese manufacturer in its niche. The company aims to narrow the gap with international leaders through innovation and market expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.57 billion, a 28.75% increase from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 124.93 million, a significant growth of over 1000%. Total assets reached RMB 3.72 billion, with steady growth in net assets and cash flow from operations. The company has shown strong profitability improvement and continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes environmentally friendly, high-performance organic pigments with superior color fastness, weather resistance, and safety, targeting high-end applications such as food packaging inks, automotive coatings, and outdoor materials. Its vertical integration of core intermediates ensures stable quality and cost advantages. The company also offers customized pigment solutions and technical support, differentiating itself through innovation, sustainability, and comprehensive service.
